system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Skills are reusable procedures injected into worker system prompts.
system_prompt_style.note: Working memory layers, identity files (SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, ROLE.md) and skills are assembled into prompts.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Hybrid recall — vector similarity + full-text search merged via Reciprocal Rank Fusion
env_context_strategy.note: Memory recall via embeddings plus agent tools (shell, file list/read, browser). Exactly how repository context is supplied is not documented in the README.

context_compaction.evidence_quote:
Channel context hits 80%
→ Compactor notices
→ Spins off a compaction worker
→ Worker summarizes old context

observation_format.evidence_quote: headless Chrome automation with accessibility-tree refs. Navigate, click, type, screenshot, manage tabs

tool_call_format.note: Rig v0.31 agentic loop with tool execution; inferred native tool calling.

tool_count.note: Tool count per process type is in ARCHITECTURE.md and tools.mdx, which are not part of the evidence.

edit_primitive.note: The README says the file tool can read, write, and list files, which suggests whole-file writes; the exact edit commands are not shown.

tool_schema_source.note: The schema source for built-in tools is not shown in the evidence.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Connect workers to external [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) servers for arbitrary tool access

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Spacebot splits the monolith into specialized processes that only do one thing, and delegate everything else.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Autonomy runs on a task state machine linked to goals, not a heartbeat.json.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: It branches to think, spawns workers to act, and stays responsive.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Workers are independent processes. Each gets a specific task, a focused prompt, and task-appropriate tools, with no conversation context.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Tasks the autonomy channel creates land in `pending_approval`. Nothing runs autonomously until you approve it.
human_in_loop.note: interface/src/components/ApprovalModal.tsx exists and may indicate per-action approval; this is not verified.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: State lives in tasks. Progress notes go on the task itself.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Spacebot's memory is a typed, graph-connected knowledge system in SQLite and LanceDB.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: After a crash, the next wake reads task metadata and picks up where things left off.

retry_policy.note: The cron circuit breaker disables a job after 3 consecutive failures; this is not a task retry policy.

termination_condition.note: Reflection runs with a capped turn budget.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Simple user messages are downgraded to cheaper models by a sub-millisecond prompt scorer with no external calls.

timeouts.evidence_quote: run arbitrary commands with configurable timeouts

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: On Linux, [bubblewrap](https://github.com/containers/bubblewrap) creates a mount namespace where the filesystem is read-only except the agent's workspace.
execution_isolation.note: Host subprocess run inside an OS sandbox (bubblewrap or sandbox-exec). A Docker deployment option and remote execution via Spacedrive are also available.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Workspace isolation — file tools reject paths outside the agent's workspace.

network_policy.evidence_quote: SSRF protection — browser tool blocks requests to cloud metadata endpoints, private IPs, loopback, and link-local addresses
network_policy.note: This is a browser blocklist rather than an allowlist; shell network policy is unknown.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Per-channel permissions — guild, channel, and DM-level access control, hot-reloadable

tracing.evidence_quote: Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoint. Opt-in via the `metrics` cargo feature flag.
tracing.note: Worker transcripts and tool calls are stored (migrations 20260223000001_worker_transcript.sql and 20260224000001_worker_tool_calls.sql).

guardrails.evidence_quote: Output scrubbing — all tool secret values are redacted from worker output before it reaches channels or LLM context.
guardrails.note: Input filters come from the Prompt Guard 2 classifier when paired with Spacedrive. Action policies come from workspace path rejection.

target_domain.evidence_quote: An AI agent for teams, communities, and multi-user environments.

open_source.evidence_quote: FSL-1.1-ALv2, [Functional Source License](https://fsl.software/), converting to Apache 2.0 after two years.
open_source.note: The source is available but FSL is not an OSI-approved licence.
